title: Persist the versioned diagnostic evidence provider

gates.name: Python typecheck
gates.command: docker compose run --rm --no-deps backend python -m mypy src/face_moment

gates.name: Diagnostic evidence persistence tests
gates.command: docker compose run --rm backend python -m pytest tests/diagnostics/test_evidence_persistence.py

evidence_required: .memory-bank/domains/diagnostic-evidence.md#postgresql-shape-and-owner-boundary RED: the accepted diagnostics code root, evidence table and repository boundary are absent, so no versioned partial/finalized bundle or promoted subset can persist independently of the core Attempt; GREEN: the next linear migration and diagnostics repository persist one bounded version-1 bundle per logical Attempt, enforce complete/incomplete gap rules, deterministic issue tags, immutable ordinary expiry and a separately retained curated promoted subset without a cross-owner cascade; decisive comparison: disposable upgrade/downgrade/re-upgrade, valid/invalid/duplicate transition matrix and database-restart reads; artifact: focused migration/repository evidence under .tasks/TASK-084-T2-FT-007-W2/.

FT-007-AC-007 RED: no diagnostics provider exists to reject participant names/annotations from ordinary evidence or isolate their later authorized promoted-subset path; GREEN: ordinary writes containing either protected field fail without stored ordinary mutation or caller exception, while only the separately authorized curated promotion boundary accepts those fields without retaining the whole bundle; decisive comparison: disposable ordinary-versus-promoted provider writes and exact owner state before/after each accepted/rejected transition; artifact: focused provider privacy evidence under .tasks/TASK-084-T2-FT-007-W2/.
purpose: Create the diagnostics-owned persistence and application boundary that later realtime, investigation, annotation and Calibration work can consume without writing promo state.
success_outcome: A bounded versioned evidence bundle can be written idempotently, remain explicitly partial or finalize complete, preserve only a curated promoted subset across ordinary expiry and survive restart with owner isolation.
anti_goals: Do not integrate the realtime consumer, add HTTP/UI routes, annotations, Log Explorer or Calibration behavior.
Do not require capture-media storage, per-crop logging, a selfie record, embeddings or a second datastore.
Do not add an empty row for every Attempt, a foreign delete cascade, cleanup history or a generic event framework.

forbidden_scope: Promo Attempt/result/session writes and foreign capability tables
Production PostgreSQL/MinIO, participant media and operator/default evidence
FT-008 role-scoped investigation, FT-009 logs, FT-010 annotations and FT-011 Calibration execution
stop_conditions: The evidence owner cannot persist without a cross-owner write or delete cascade.
A sufficient bundle would require mandatory capture media, embeddings, credentials or personalized session data.
The migration cannot follow TASK-083's actual revision as one linear stream.
Repository proof cannot use a disposable database with safe cleanup.

constraints: Primary owner and code root are diagnostics under src/face_moment/diagnostics/; its public application boundary returns non-throwing write outcomes to promo consumers.
Use one logical attempt_id without an ownership-crossing delete cascade and create no mandatory empty anchor for absent evidence.

Bound and validate JSON version, finite numeric values, issue tags and partial/final state; reject embeddings, credentials, auth/session payloads, commercial originals and participant names/annotations from ordinary evidence.
Use a disposable database with unique records, known initial state, restart read, safe rerun and owned cleanup; resolve the actual direct Alembic predecessor dynamically.
invariants: Diagnostics is the only writer of diagnostic_evidence and never mutates core Attempt/result/session state.
Absent evidence is derived incomplete without an empty row; a partial row has an explicit gap and expired ordinary content cannot be restored.
Ordinary evidence contains no participant name or annotation; only the separately authorized promoted-subset boundary may accept those curated fields.
Promotion retains only the curated subset and never extends the entire ordinary bundle or Promo screenshot.
The table introduces no mandatory capture-media, selfie, log or replay storage.
verification_targets: Disposable migration/repository fixtures prove exact fields/constraints, one logical row, partial-to-complete finalization, invalid-write rejection, restart persistence, expiry irreversibility and promoted-subset preservation.

An ordinary-versus-promoted matrix rejects participant names/annotations in ordinary_manifest while admitting only the authorized curated fields through promoted_subset without retaining the whole ordinary bundle.
Ownership/schema scans prove one Base/Alembic stream, no cross-owner cascade/direct promo write and no mandatory capture-media/selfie/embedding/credential/session payload.
